WELCOME TO GREEN MEADOWS

Calling all news detectives!

2–6 players · one device

Stay curious. Build your case. Original sample cards · Labeled sample actions · Scripted guide

QUICK RULES

Ready, detective?

  1. Look: 1 news card, 4 context clues. Start with 5 cards.
  2. Your turn: play an action if you like. Then draw OR drop.
  3. Build a case: pick REAL or FAKE evidence. +1 uses news; +2 / +3 uses shown context.
  4. Drop: everyone shows their case. Talk about which clues fit.
  5. Score: most evidence points wins the round. Winner +1; tied winners +1 each.

It’s about your evidence—not guessing the “right” answer.

Sample actions & demo choices

Extra clues: draw up to 2. Sneaky sheep: take 1 random card. Flock swap: swap hands. Then draw or drop. These are sample effects, not copied original action cards.

Demo finish: first to 3 or 5 round wins. New decks each round; starting player rotates. Empty draw pile: drop. An empty case scores zero. Players agree which cards count; the guide never judges. More details are under Welcome.
